visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and bangs is shown in a medium close-up shot, smiling brightly against a soft-focus indoor background with natural light. She wears a beige ribbed knit top and points to her cheeks, showcasing her clean white teeth. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of three tubes of O'right toothpaste (green, pink, and grey) standing on a reflective surface near a window. A hand reaches out and touches the top of the grey tube. (3) The woman is seen sitting on a white sofa, holding the three toothpaste tubes and smiling towards the camera. The lighting is warm and airy, emphasizing a lifestyle aesthetic. (4) Close-up shot of the woman holding a pink toothpaste tube near her face while smiling. She then looks up and to the side as if imagining something pleasant. (5) A montage follows, showing a retail shelf stocked with various toothpastes, a laboratory demonstration with beakers and a blue liquid, and a split-screen comparison showing the woman brushing her teeth labeled 'O'right' on the top and 'Other' on the bottom. (6) A detailed graphic appears showing a tooth surrounded by natural ingredients like wood and herbs, followed by laboratory test result charts labeled RDA11 and PCR50. (7) Various international award logos and certificates (USDA, SGS) are displayed over product shots. (8) The woman is back on screen, demonstrating brushing her teeth with the green and then the pink toothpaste, looking happy and confident. (9) The video ends with the three toothpaste tubes on a white surface and a final shot of the woman smiling and waving.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for O'right natural toothpaste. It aims to persuade viewers that typical whitening toothpastes are harmful due to chemical abrasives, while O'right offers a safe, 100% natural, and effective alternative backed by scientific certifications and international awards.
